svg.title: Terraform scoping before and after: one production workspace versus domain-scoped workspaces
svg.desc: On the left, one production workspace holds every service's ecs, alb, network, storage, iam and secrets resources with no boundaries; a service's six resources light up one at a time in scattered positions. On the right, the same resources sit inside a workspace per domain and light up together as a group. The highlight cycles through six services.
